responsibility: Declares the generated pass-3 parser entry point. Its exported `CompilationUnit` routine performs the final semantic parse that emits gm2 quadruples for executable code and module bodies, assuming declarations and types have already been established by earlier passes.
same_name_distinction: This is the interface file for the pass-3 parser, exporting CompilationUnit only; unlike P3Build.bnf, it does not define the grammar productions or semantic actions for executable-code parsing.
